title: Cicero is killed on the orders of Mark Antony
summary: The orator and statesman Cicero was caught and killed near his villa at Formiae. His head and hands were displayed in the Forum.
reason: Cicero had attacked Mark Antony in his Philippics, and Antony insisted on his name being placed on the proscription lists of the Second Triumvirate.
significance: His death symbolised the end of the free Republic, and his writings shaped Latin prose for centuries.
